digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com.title: African Agriculture Adaptation Atlas STAC catalog
digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com.summary: This STAC contains the data used within the Africa Agriculture Adaptation Atlas project found [here](https://adaptationatlas.cgiar.org/). This includes data related to climate hazards, crop production, crop exposure to climate hazards, demographics and more across Sub-Saharan Africa.

data.source.coop.title: Agroforestry Tree Detection — India (STAC layer)
data.source.coop.summary: Separate STAC layer over the Croissant/ML dataset (files unchanged): COG + original + labels per Item.

data.source.coop.title: Argentina National Geographic Institute (IGN) Reference Layers
data.source.coop.summary: Official reference layers from Argentina's National Geographic Institute (IGN), extracted from its WFS service and published as cloud-optimized GeoParquet. Includes hydrography, geomorphology and relief, transportation and road infrastructure, administrative boundaries, settlements and buildings, vegetation, geodesy, and other categories from IGN's vector data model. Public-use data under Article 2 of Law 27.275 (Public Information Access Law).

data.source.coop.title: Disaster Data Releases from Planet Labs PBC
data.source.coop.summary: Planet Crisis Response Program imagery for major disaster events — earthquakes, floods, storms, wildfires and human-made disasters — as a single browsable STAC / Portolan catalog. Each event is a self-contained sub-catalog with pre- and post-event high-resolution COGs (visual, pansharpened-analytic and usable-data masks), organised by affected location. Imagery © Planet Labs PBC, licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial).

data.source.coop.title: Distributed Renewable Energy (DRE) Atlas
data.source.coop.summary: This collection hosts the underlying data for the [DRE Atlas Planning Platform](https://dre.energydata.info), settlement-level data for distributed renewable energy (DRE) planning, covering over 1.9 million settlements across 58 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, the Pacific, and the Americas.

data.source.coop.title: EuroSAT: Dataset for Land Use and Land Cover Classification
data.source.coop.summary: EuroSAT is a land use and land cover classification dataset. It is based on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery covering 13 spectral bands and consists of 10 LULC classes with a total of 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images. The dataset is associated with the publications "Introducing EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification" and "EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification".

data.source.coop.title: GHSL Population Grids (GHS-POP R2023A)
data.source.coop.summary: A cloud-native mirror of the European Commission Joint Research Centre's GHS-POP R2023A population grids: twelve five-yearly epochs from 1975 to 2030 at 100 m in World Mollweide (ESRI:54009). The upstream rasters are stored in Deflated ZIP members without internal overviews, preventing partial reads over HTTP. This mirror converts them to Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs with overviews and embedded statistics. It is a derived, lossy product: pixel values are quantized to 0.01 persons per cell and are not bit-identical to JRC's distribution. The grid, model, inputs, authors, and licence are unchanged. See the [catalog agent guide](AGENTS.md) for query recipes and [why this mirror exists](https://github.com/nlebovits/ghsl/blob/main/docs/upstream-gaps.md) for measurements.

data.source.coop.title: HDX HAPI Cloud-Native
data.source.coop.summary: Cloud-native Parquet exports of the UN OCHA Humanitarian API (HAPI), which provides standardized humanitarian indicators designed for seamless interoperability from multiple sources. Covers affected people, food security, funding, conflict, operational presence, and more. Individual dataset licenses vary — see source links.

data.source.coop.title: JRC GloFAS Global Flood Hazard Maps
data.source.coop.summary: Global riverine flood hazard maps from the Joint Research Centre CEMS-GLOFAS v2.1.2. Includes flood depth and hazard classification rasters for return periods 10, 20, 50, 75, 100, 200, and 500 years, plus permanent water body and spurious depth auxiliary layers.

data.source.coop.title: LUCAS ML
data.source.coop.summary: The LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area Frame Survey) dataset supports machine learning segmentation for land-use and land-cover change analysis and biodiversity measurement. This analysis-ready dataset provides segmented LUCAS survey photos with ancillary information and summary statistics, supporting land-cover change validation, vegetation detection and characterization, and biodiversity and landscape heterogeneity monitoring.

data.source.coop.title: MapBiomas Annual Land Cover and Land Use, South America
data.source.coop.summary: Annual land cover and land use maps from the MapBiomas Project for ten South American countries, 2019-2024, as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs at 30 m. One collection per country, one item per year. Pixel values are the raw national MapBiomas class codes - nothing was reclassified. Because each MapBiomas national initiative maintains its own legend, codes are not comparable across borders as published; the README documents a three-tier harmonisation (exact level-1 collapse, a pan-MapBiomas legend, and a corrected crosswalk onto MapBiomas Brazil Collection 10) and ships it as a machine-readable harmonization.csv.

data.source.coop.title: Microsoft ML Road Detections
data.source.coop.summary: A cloud-native mirror of the road detections Microsoft mines from Bing Maps aerial imagery and publishes at [microsoft/RoadDetections](https://github.com/microsoft/RoadDetections). Microsoft distributes the data as nineteen zipped TSV files of GeoJSON, one per UN subregion. This catalog republishes the same roads as GeoParquet partitioned by country, so a reader can query one country, one bounding box, or the whole planet without downloading 67 GB first.

data.source.coop.title: NAIP Aerial Imagery Mosaics
data.source.coop.summary: Cloud-native mirror Collections of National Agriculture Imagery Program scenes, modelled as per-scene STAC Items whose Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs stay on the host that publishes them.

data.source.coop.title: National geospatial data of the Republic of Moldova
data.source.coop.summary: A cloud-native mirror of the Moldovan national geoportal geodata.gov.md, run by Î.S. INGEOCAD for the Agency for Geodesy, Cartography and Cadastre (AGCC). It holds vector layers extracted over WFS: cadastral parcels, buildings, addresses, the 2017 base map, CORINE land cover, the state forest fund, flood models, and the geodetic network. Data is published as GeoParquet and PMTiles in the source coordinate system, MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026). This is not an official AGCC product.

data.source.coop.title: Pergamino SDI: Spatial Data Infrastructure
data.source.coop.summary: Cloud-native mirror of the Spatial Data Infrastructure (SDI) of the Municipality of Pergamino, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. Data is published by the Municipality's Directorate of Georeferenced Information Systems (DSIG) and is republished here in cloud-native formats (GeoParquet, PMTiles) without altering its content.

data.source.coop.title: Portolan NL — Cloud-Native Dutch Geodata
data.source.coop.summary: A demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for the disclosure of open geodatasets from Dutch government authorities. Inspired by PDOK (Publieke Dienstverlening Op de Kaart), this catalog provides current and reliable geo-information as GeoParquet, PMTiles, and STAC metadata — open, standards-based, and freely accessible to everyone.

data.source.coop.title: Portolan Reference Catalog
data.source.coop.summary: A mixed reference catalog exercising every major case in the Portolan v0.1 specification with real, openly licensed data pulled from its original upstream sources, vector polygons and points, raster, tabular, mirror provenance, nested catalogs and flat collections.

data.source.coop.title: Soft Commodity Infrastructure (Brazil)
data.source.coop.summary:
This is the geolocated midstream of Brazilian agriculture: the silos, slaughterhouses, dairy plants, and sugar/ethanol
mills that farms sell into, plus the cooperatives that farms belong to. It exists
to answer, for any rural property, **who to contact** about deforestation on the
land — the cooperative that has the farmer as a member, or the buyer that receives
their grain, cattle, or cane.

data.source.coop.title: South American Rural Cadastral Boundaries
data.source.coop.summary: Cadastral parcel boundaries for South American rural land use and supply chain analysis. Intended for use alongside Trazo agricultural field boundaries and Fields of The World.

data.source.coop.title: The Wildland Almanac - California
data.source.coop.summary: Root catalog for The Wildland Almanac - California, a 30 m Landsat-derived data cube of wildland ecosystem properties spanning water years 1985-2025. Each annual release is a complete reprocessing of the full time series and is published as a versioned sub-catalog; the current release is v2026.1.

data.source.coop.title: The Wildland Almanac - CONUS
data.source.coop.summary: Root catalog for The Wildland Almanac - CONUS, a 30 m Landsat-derived data cube of wildland ecosystem properties at decadal snapshots (water years 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, 2024). Each release is a complete reprocessing of the full snapshot set and is published as a versioned sub-catalog; the current release is v2026.1.

data.source.coop.title: The Wildland Almanac - Treatment Scenarios
data.source.coop.summary: Root catalog for The Wildland Almanac - Treatment Scenarios, a 30 m Landsat-derived data cube of wildland ecosystem properties for 24 BlueForest management-treatment scenarios applied to the 2024 western-CONUS baseline. Each release regenerates the full treatment set from the current baseline and is published as a versioned sub-catalog; the current release is v2026.1.

data.source.coop.title: Trazo Field Boundaries of South America
data.source.coop.summary: 10.9 million agricultural field boundaries across South America for the 2023–2024 planting season, delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery by the Trazo model suite (U-Net / EfficientNet-B3, built on Fields of The World). Published as three collections, one per model — trazo3-fields is recommended for most use cases. Intended to support supply chain traceability, EUDR compliance workflows, and field-level deforestation monitoring.

data.source.coop.title: TriMet Geospatial Data
data.source.coop.summary: A cloud-native mirror of the eight geospatial datasets TriMet publishes at [developer.trimet.org/gis](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/) — the transit district boundary, fixed-route alignments, rail lines, stops, route stops, rail stops, transit centers and park and rides for the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area.

storage.googleapis.com.title: California Forest Observatory
storage.googleapis.com.summary: The Forest Observatory is a data-driven forest monitoring system that maps the drivers of wildfire behavior across the state with a focus on vegetation fuels. Data are available for non-commercial use under the Forest Observatory [terms of use](https://forestobservatory.com/legal.html).

storage.googleapis.com.title: Extremadura SDI (CICTEX)
storage.googleapis.com.summary: Portolan catalog with a selection of geospatial data from the Regional Government of Extremadura (CICTEX), originally distributed via the SITEX Download Centre (sitex.juntaex.es/SITEX/centrodescargas). Data has been reprojected to EPSG:4326 and converted to cloud-native formats (GeoParquet, PMTiles); this is not the official distribution. Licensed CC-BY 4.0 CICTEX, Junta de Extremadura. This catalog is a publishing demo using Portolan and is not an official data source.

storage.googleapis.com.title: Google Earth Engine
storage.googleapis.com.summary: List of all rasters and vectors present in the [Google Earth Engine Catalog](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/).

This open SAR dataset contains > 100 Capella Space scenes. 

Imaging modes: Spotlight, Stripmap and Sliding Spotlight. 

Image product types: Single Look Complex (SLC), Geocoded Terrain Corrected (GEO), Geocoded Ellipsoid Corrected (GEC) and Sensor Independent Complex Data (SICD)

vims.univ-nantes.fr.summary: [Cassini/VIMS infrared dataset](https://vims.univ-nantes.fr) hosted at the University of Nantes.

ciesin.github.io.title: CIESIN STAC
ciesin.github.io.summary: CIESIN STAC is the authoritative SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog for datasets produced and curated by the Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN) and affiliated programs, including GRID3.

coclico.blob.core.windows.net.title: CoCliCo STAC Catalog
coclico.blob.core.windows.net.summary: The funded CoCliCo project enhances coastal risk management by offering an open-source platform for assessing sea-level rise impacts. It visualizes, analyzes, and contextualizes coastal risks, combining geospatial data with decision tools, uniting experts in adaptation and risk communication.

spatio-temporal-asset-catalog.s3.ap-sout.title: CoRE Stack Spatio Temporal Asset Catalog

esa.pages.eox.at.title: Cubes and Clouds - Snow Cover

s3.eu-central-1.wasabisys.com.summary: European layers organized / produced by GeoHarmonizer (project 2018-EU-IA-0095) and publicly available in [EcoDataCube](https://ecodatacube.eu) including Landsat and Sentinel-2 images, land cover & land use maps, tree species occurrences and soil predictions.

fiboa.org.title: fiboa Field Boundaries

This STAC catalog provides a collection of field boundary data from various sources, but all converted to be fiboa compliant.

nasa-iserv.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com.title: NASA ISERV

nz-coastal.s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.c.title: New Zealand Coastal Elevation

pgc-opendata-dems.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.title: Polar Geospatial Center Data Catalog

rosetta-3dcomet.cnes.fr.title: Rosetta OSIRIS Anaglyphs of Comet 67P
